description: Hi. I love figuring out how things work, and then trying to build them myself. Robotics is my favourite: there’s something exciting about writing a few lines of code and watching a machine move because of it. I enjoy building things with my hands, from small models to circuits, and I like coding just as much, whether it’s a game, a website or a robot’s brain. Space Traveller started the same way, as an idea I wanted to see come to life.
